Transparent by design

Every record starts with a source.

This is a 20-person research sample, not a verified marketing list. Contact details were retrieved from publicly accessible business pages and indexed source excerpts on November 13, 2026. Each record links to its evidence.

  1. Find the practitioner. Prioritize independent EA and tax practices; require evidence of client-facing accounting or tax work. Exclude generic inboxes, administrative staff and known large CPA firms.
  2. Record published details. Capture the person-associated email, business phone, role, firm, location where available, and source URL. No email patterns were invented.
  3. Inspect exceptions. Business phone area code is not proof of physical location. Headcount remains unconfirmed, even where a site presents one practitioner or a short team list. Ling’s business-styled Gmail and Edward’s mailbox association need direct ownership confirmation. Jasmine’s source is a third-party business directory.
  4. Finish qualification. Confirm fewer than 10 total staff, current client-facing role and location; verify named mailbox ownership and deliverability with an email-verification provider. Exclude invalid, catch-all, unknown and shared inboxes unless the client explicitly accepts them.

Scope to clarify with the client

The brief includes CPAs but excludes “public accounting firms.” This sample focuses on independent tax and EA practices and avoids CPA-branded firms. Confirm the intended exclusion before scaling. Phone area codes are used as a screening criterion, with physical location shown separately.

A reviewable 10-contact sample

Use “Select first 10” as a starting shortlist or select any contacts manually. Export downloads selected contacts when there is a selection; otherwise it downloads the current filtered view. Qualification notes and evidence links are included. Selection is saved only in this browser.

Scaling estimate: Do not promise a fixed number of hours for 1,000 accepted contacts from this small sample. First measure research time per accepted record and the rejection rate after headcount and mailbox verification.
